skills.description:
Nelliel swings her Zanpakuto, dealing 5 hits for a total damage equal to 870% of ATK and triggering 1 instance(s) of Verde Rush, while generating Spiritual Pressure and Battlefield Skill Energy. Landing the 5th hit grants 1 point(s) of Battle Will and 1 point(s) of Friendship. ~~Instant Conclusion~~ At maximum Spiritual Pressure, releasing a counterattack, Rapid Slash, or the final hit of Basic Attack will automatically trigger an additional Basic Attack 
 Nelliel leaps above the enemy and cleaves downward, dealing damage equal to 1110% of ATK and triggering 1 instance(s) of Verde Rush. She also gains 1 point(s) of Battle Will and 1 point(s) of Friendship, and restore HP to all teammates equal to 50% + 1000 of her ATK. 
 If this attack is release while Nelliel is in the Build Up state, switching to a teammate within 8 seconds of the final hit will automatically trigger their counterattack upon their first switch-in. The damage and Spiritual Pressure Reduction Rate of this counterattack are reduced by 50%. ~~Piercing Charge~~ Resurreccion 
 Nelliel swings her lance, dealing 5 hits for a total damage equal to 1300% of ATK and triggering 1 instance(s) of Verde Rush. Landing the 5th hit grants 1 point(s) of Battle Will. ~~Lance Execution~~ During Resurreccion, tap and hold Basic Attack with at least 2 points of Battle Will 
 Nelliel swings her lance to strike the enemy, then leaps up and pins them to the ground before detonating the impact, dealing damage equal to 1665% of ATK and triggering 1 instance(s) of Verde Rush. 
  Releasing this skill consumes 2 point(s) of Battle Will and can directly chain into the 4th hit of her basic attack.
skills.name: Rational Blade

skills.description:
Nelliel slashes the enemy twice before delivering a powerful kick, dealing damage equal to 1797.5% of ATK and triggering 1 instance(s) of Verde Rush, while generating Spiritual Pressure and Battlefield Skill Energy. 
 Upon release, she gains 2 point(s) of Battle Will and 2 point(s) of Friendship. ~~Cleaving Throw~ Resurreccion 
 Nelliel throws her lance at the enemy, dealing damage equal to 270% of ATK and inflicting 10 Verde Rush Point(s). ~~Verde Whirl~~ After releasing Cleaving Throw, tap technique again with at least 2 points of Battle Will 
 Nelliel teleports next to the enemy, pulls out her lance and thrusts again, dealing damage equal to 2417.5% of ATK and triggering 1 instance(s) of Verde Rush, pulling in nearby enemies during the release. 
 This skill consumes 2 points of Battle Will, increases the cooldown of regular Techniques by 10 second(s), and can directly chain into the 4th hit of her basic attack.
skills.name: Rapid Slash

skills.description:
Nelliel Ascends her Zanpakuto and releases the power sealed within to enter Resurreccion, transforming into Gamuza and charging the target, dealing damage equal to 3322.5% of ATK and triggering 1 instance(s) of Verde Rush. 
 During Resurreccion, all of Nelliel's attacks are enhanced, and she gains Iron Body and a shield equal to 100% + 2000 of her ATK and grants protection to the next teammate upon switching out. While in Resurreccion, the Battlefield Skills, Combo Attack, cannot be triggered, and the Battlefield Skill, Cero Sincretico, cannot be actively released. ~~Lanzador Verde~~ During Resurreccion, release ultimate again at Max Ultimate Energy 
 Nelliel condenses Spirit Charge and hurls her lance at the enemy, dealing damage equal to 5547.5% of ATK and triggering 1 times of Verde Rush. After releasing, Resurreccion ends, and refreshes the shield. 
 While Nelliel's Battlefield Skill is active, switching to a teammate within 8 seconds of the final hit will automatically trigger their counterattack upon their first switch-in. The damage and Spiritual Pressure Reduction Rate of this counterattack are reduced by 50%.
skills.name: Praise, Gamuza

skills.description:
Nelliel seizes the opening created by countering the enemy to slash them multiple times, dealing damage equal to 1395% of ATK and triggering 1 instance(s) of Verde Rush. On hit, she generates Spiritual Pressure and Battlefield Skill Energy, and can directly chain into the 4th of her basic attack. 
 Upon a successful counter, she gains 1 point(s) of Battle Will and 1 point(s) of Friendship. ~~Heroic Stomp~~ Resurreccion 
 Nelliel stomps the enemy and pins them with her lance, then dives down from the air, dealing total damage equal to 2080% of ATK and triggering 1 instance(s) of Verde Rush. After landing, she can directly chain into the 4th hit of her basic attack. This skill can also be manually released once by holding Counter, consuming 3 point(s) of Battle Will.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description:
~~While Nelliel's Battlefield Skill is active, all allies gain 60% Ailment Mastery.~~ 
 
 Nelliel's Battlefield Skills consume two types of energy, Battlefield Skill Energy and Friendship, corresponding to Combo Attack and Cero Sincretico, respectively. Both types of energy are generated through Nelliel's attacks and have a 1.2 second cooldown. ~~Combo Attack~~ 
 When another teammate's attacks hit an enemy, 10 Battlefield Skill Energy is automatically consumed to trigger Nelliel's Combo Attack, dealing damage equal to 240% of her ATK and applying 20 Verde Rush Point(s). If the target takes another instance of Ailment DMG within 2 seconds, Combo Attack is triggered once more without consuming Battlefield Skill Energy. This effect has a 1 second cooldown. 
 Each Combo Attack triggered by consuming Battlefield Skill Energy grants 1 point(s) of Friendship. ~~Cero Sincretico~~ Reach 15 points of Friendship 
 Pesche and Dondochakka will come to Nelliel and release Cero Sincretico on enemies, dealing damage equal to 2997.5% of ATK and granting Nelliel the Build Up state.
skills.name: For My Friend

rationale: Nelliel is in Tier S as no other units provides as many benefits as she does. Her Verde Rush passive doubles Gin's Ailment DMG (Enemy has 50% Ailment resistance reduction) and similarly increases True Shikai Ichigo's ailment weighing. It's likely Ichigo will do less Ailment DMG with a new Thrust Tactic unless they also have a 50% Ailment resistance shred.

The majority of Nel's damage comes from Ailment and Ultimates. Her own stamp set is too good to miss out on, though there have been cases where Kenpachi stamps could be used for Nel Double Support teams. Recommended passievs are All DMG and Ult DMG for standard builds. With True Shikai's release, it is recommended to build Nel as a full support and give her Invigorate - Tactic.

Unfortunately, Nelliel is a unit whose playstyle/convenience changes drastically with B6. As of July 2026, it is recommended to wait for a new Thrust Tactic if you currently have no intentions of pulling for B6 Nel.
Nel should perform better with Toshiro Bond instead of her own, though tests suggest the ATK Bond is also useable for True Shikai teams.
For B6 True Shikai teams, 168% Ult Charge is recommended to skip the followup explosion from her Special Attack in Resurrecion.
At B4, 55% Crit Rate on stats page is enough to always guarantee crits.
